_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in the blanks. Keep config.json private (it has your password).
_companies_help: Put the company name exactly as it appears in Tally, e.g. ["Chacha Traders"]. Leave as [""] to use whichever company is currently open in Tally.
_starlane_help: apiBase = where the Starlane backend runs. Log in with your Starlane account email + password. Leave token empty (advanced use only).
_voucherTypes_help: Which Tally voucher types to send. Sales->receivables, Purchase->payables, Receipt/Payment->bank money in/out. Stock items on Sales/Purchase vouchers sync inventory automatically.
_dates_help: Leave blank to auto-use this financial year (1 April) to today. Or set YYYYMMDD, e.g. 20260401.
_interval_help: For --watch mode: how often to auto-sync, in minutes.
